cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Focal point, yes. I've put the rent letter in the middle of the table, like you did with the flowers. How do the curtains look?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Focal point means what you want people to notice. We need to read that letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, the whole room together. Let's put the flowers back and take a picture of the curtains for the landlord.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll include the letter so he knows which overdue payment we're asking about.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, include everything. Put the vase in front of the envelope, though; you arranged those flowers so well. Show me that arrangement again.

reason: Create specific misunderstood language or copied behavior, then make the subsequent Drive tactics respond to B rather than merely add confident phrases.
